purpose: Exploratory measured-input correction, not constitutive fitting
prior_exposure: Nominal-angle prediction outcomes have already been inspected. The first three board quaternions of pilot 1 for each material have been inspected. No candidate forecast outcomes have been computed before this protocol.
fixed: Published friction, g=9.81, nominal downhill measurement axis, all baseline trial roles, onset, prefix and forecast frames remain unchanged.
candidate: Average the world normals obtained by applying source xyzw board quaternions to local +z over the same four conditioning frames; normalize and require positive z. Assume the released board xy plane is its support surface. Use projected gravity minus mu*g*normal_z times its unit downhill direction, projected onto the baseline measurement axis. Hold that acceleration constant during the forecast.
audit: Quaternion versus source ZYX Euler agreement; plane stability and normal-motion residual are diagnostics, never tuned corrections.
selection: Keep every baseline/candidate error and all regressions. No material updates or candidate selection by outcome; report improvement or rejection separately per material.
scope: Single sliding branch conditioned on a four-frame motion prefix. Does not validate the full impulse/spin contact model, static friction or independent material characterization.
